declared: confirmatory for the co-primary, descriptive for the secondary
question: can a method tell a chain that has a cryptic pocket from a chain examined against every deposited holo partner and shown to have none
why_this_question_is_new: every accuracy number on this benchmark is a within-chain ranking on chains that have a pocket. None of them can be low because a method hallucinates a pocket on a chain that has none, because no such chain is in the evaluation

the_sets.clusters_are_disjoint: one unit per UniRef50 cluster across the whole funnel, so a cluster contributes a positive or a negative and never both

geometry_field.why_not: it has never been scored on Set A's positives and must not be: a spent set cannot confirm a second method. It appears in the secondary, which reads only Set N

statistic.unit_score: mean of the method's 10 highest residue scores on that unit
statistic.why_k_is_ten: Set A's positive units carry a median of 16 cryptic residues, so ten sits below the size of a real pocket while a single maximum would let one outlying residue be the whole statistic
statistic.outcome: ROC-AUC over all units, positive unit against negative unit
statistic.why_rank_based: invariant to any monotone rescaling, so the comparison cannot be won or lost on the units a method's scores happen to be in
statistic.residues_used: the intersection of the residues all methods scored on that unit, as the Set A read did, so a paired difference is paired

co_primary.resampling_unit: the unit, stratified by positive or negative

secondary.name: geometry_field_on_set_n_only
secondary.what: the mean top-10 unit score of geometry_field and of table_field over Set N alone, paired by unit
secondary.reads: Set N only, so it spends nothing of Set A

secondary.name: as_deployed_false_alarms
secondary.what: for each method, the fraction of Set N units on which it calls at least one residue at its own deployed operating point, and the mean fraction of residues called
secondary.level: descriptive, and confounded with each method's own calibration, which is why it is not primary

control_fixed_in_advance.name: chain_length_alone
control_fixed_in_advance.what: the same ROC-AUC with each unit's score replaced by its residue count
control_fixed_in_advance.why: Set N's chains are chains whose partners bind without moving a pocket. If they are systematically shorter than Set A's, a method that scores short chains lower separates the halves without knowing anything about pockets
control_fixed_in_advance.how_it_is_used: every method's AUC is reported against this number as well as against 0.5, in the same table

outcome_sentences_written_in_advance.all_three_resolved_in_our_favour: On 384 external units the counting field separates chains that have a cryptic pocket from chains shown to have none better than all three published baselines, at a Bonferroni-corrected level. This is a property no published comparison on this benchmark measures, and it is reported with the chain-length control that was fixed before the read.
outcome_sentences_written_in_advance.some_resolved: The counting field separates chains with a cryptic pocket from chains shown to have none better than some published baselines and not others. The comparisons that resolved and the ones that did not are both listed, at the corrected level.
outcome_sentences_written_in_advance.none_resolved: On 384 external units no comparison of unit-level detection between the counting field and a published baseline resolved at the corrected level. The question the set was built to ask has an answer that this set is too small to give.
outcome_sentences_written_in_advance.resolved_against_us: On 384 external units a published baseline separates chains that have a cryptic pocket from chains shown to have none better than the counting field does, at a Bonferroni-corrected level. The advantage is real and is recorded here because the plan named the sentence before the number existed.
outcome_sentences_written_in_advance.control_dominates: Chain length alone separates the two halves at an AUC that leaves no room to read the methods' numbers as knowledge of pockets. The read is reported and no method comparison is drawn from it.

what_this_cannot_show: that a Set N chain has no pocket. It has no pocket that a holo structure deposited before the cutoff reveals
anything about affinity, druggability, or any clinical property
changes_forbidden_after_this_file_is_com: the unit score, k, the statistic, the bootstrap seed or count
any architecture, threshold or quantisation rule of any method
the addition of a method to the co-primary
